headline: CHW @ PHI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHW 3.63 at PHI 4.16, with a projected total of 7.79. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward PHI: CHW moved +0.47 runs while PHI moved +0.90, changing the projected margin by -0.43 runs. The projected total climbed +1.37, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Brandon Eisert has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Chase Meidroth, Brandon Marsh, Kyle Schwarber, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Garrett Stubbs, Edmundo Sosa because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
